Definition: Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region
BiblicalUsage: Magog was a son of Japheth, named in the table of nations in 1 Chronicles 1:5, and the name later stands for the northern land itself: Ezekiel 38:2 tells the prophet to set his face against Gog, the land of Magog, and Ezekiel 39:6 says God will send a fire on Magog. He is named in the table of nations as a son of Japheth, and his name later covers a whole northern land.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Magog's arc runs from a name in a genealogy to a nation under judgment, and that God keeps both ends of the story in His hand.
